title: EgoForce dataset on Hugging Face: about 2,000 hours of egocentric video and hand motion paired with calibrated tactile force
summary: First subset of EgoForce is public: 40K episodes, 1,000 tasks and 1,000 demonstrators, aimed at force-aware human-to-robot transfer and dexterous manipulation. Paper and project page are linked, with more data to be uploaded.

appearances.summary: FACT is a Force-Action-Track foundation model trained on 2,000 hours of force-rich human demonstrations in the EgoForce dataset. The demo shows dexterous control such as playing a harp, tying shoelaces, and wet-lab manipulation.
